يستكبرا (form X)
# يَسْتَكْبِرَا (yastakbirā) /jas.tak.bi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# يُسْتَكْبَرَا (yustakbarā) /jus.tak.ba.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
